name: clock_utc
description: datetime.utcnow() and utcfromtimestamp(), whose naive results are compared with naive stored dates. Hidden tests require the results to stay naive.

hidden_tests.tests/test_clock_hidden.py:
from datetime import datetime

from billing.clock import expiry, from_timestamp, now


def test_results_stay_naive():
    assert now().tzinfo is None
    assert expiry(1).tzinfo is None
    assert from_timestamp(86400) == datetime(1970, 1, 2)
    assert from_timestamp(86400).tzinfo is None


def test_now_is_utc_not_local_time():
    assert abs((now() - datetime(2000, 1, 1)).days) > 9000
